subject: Educação Física
description_pt: Experimentar e fruir diversos tipos de esportes de campo e taco, rede/parede e invasão, identificando seus elementos comuns e criando estratégias individuais e coletivas básicas para sua execução, prezando pelo trabalho coletivo e pelo protagonismo.

components.description_pt: Explorar e apreciar esportes de rebatida/campo, rede/parede e invasão através da participação
components.description_en: Explore and appreciate striking/fielding, net/wall, and invasion sports through participation

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos comuns compartilhados entre diferentes categorias de esportes
components.description_en: Identify common elements shared among different categories of sports
components.cc_component_description: Understand that shapes in different categories may share attributes

components.description_pt: Desenvolver estratégias individuais básicas para participação em esportes explorados
components.description_en: Develop basic individual strategies for participation in explored sports

components.description_pt: Demonstrar agência do estudante e esforço colaborativo durante atividades esportivas
components.description_en: Demonstrate student agency and collaborative effort during sport activities
components.cc_component_description: Follow established rules for collegial discussion and collaborative decision-making

cc_matches.description: Follow rules for collegial discussions and decision-making, track progress toward specific goals and deadlines, and define individual roles as needed.

Understand that shapes in different categories (e.g., rhombuses, rectangles, and others) may share attributes (e.g., having four sides), and that the shared attributes can define a larger category (e.g., quadrilaterals). Recognize rhombuses, rectangles, and squares as examples of quadrilaterals, and draw examples of quadrilaterals that do not belong to any of these subcategories.
